format: BLOOM local leader preview and netcode load evidence v1

localRafPreviewOn.kind: Actual Chromium 153.0.8010.12 + SwiftShader WebGL, production RAF/deadline/input; not phone hardware or actual RTC

instrumentedActorBreakdown.kind: Separate 6-second diagnostic run with render-substage wrappers enabled; instrumentation adds overhead, so these are attribution samples, not speed-comparison results. drawUnit includes nested RallyArt.draw.
instrumentedActorBreakdown.interpretation: Per-unit art preparation is the dominant measured CPU substage after mesh geometry reuse; this identifies the next optimization area but not a fix. The mesh-submit wrapper did not observe calls on this path.

mesh.interpretation: Retained mesh geometry is reused; preview scope installations and actor-render CPU remain costly. Short samples vary substantially, especially at 1000 units.

actualTwoPeerLoad.kind: Two independent Chromium tabs, production RAF/deadline, signed local Nostr signaling and native WebRTC data channels; local fixture, not public relay/NAT/mobile certification
actualTwoPeerLoad.fixture: 500 stunned friendly units added to the coordinator's initial shared snapshot; each peer observed 505 total world units
actualTwoPeerLoad.rtc: Both native peer connections stayed connected with bidirectional input/control bytes.
limitations: One tab was not the foreground render surface, so its FPS is not comparable to a single foreground mobile game.
The multiplayer load fixture freezes the added units to isolate shared snapshot/render/network load; active 500/1000-unit simulation is measured separately by the local RAF benchmark.

An earlier full edge-case suite under this load exceeded its 10-second page-observation deadline during refresh while both worlds remained playing; the focused soak above passed and does not claim loaded refresh/rejoin coverage.

browser155.kind: Chromium + SwiftShader; 80 deterministic measured ticks and an explicit render per tick; not production timer/network

native1000.kind: Native V8 actual game engine; 1000 friendly units, 30 TPS, 80 deterministic measured ticks, no renderer/network

netcodeModeBench.publicRollbackAttempt: Rejected before joining: PUBLIC_CONNECTION_FAILED / 'Public rooms require lockstep'. No rollback-mode public RTC performance or correctness claim is made.
netcodeModeBench.conclusion: Current data does not justify switching the public mode from lockstep to rollback.
